title: Catalogue
purpose: The label's actual daily job: what is missing. Which songs are unmeasured, which have no approved kit, whose consent is stale.

children.source: Scope of the current query — tenant, filters applied, records matched
children.note: These are cross-collection questions. Answering them by scanning every record is what this screen must be built to avoid.

items.label: Songs with no approved kit
items.source: count of Song with no Kit at approval=approved

children.title: Gaps
children.hint: One row per song, with each precondition shown as met or missing.

children.note: State reads as form, not only as text — a missing precondition should be visible without reading the cell.

children.title: Spend
children.hint: What generation has cost across the catalogue, and what remains available.

children.source: Budget threshold — generation refused before enqueue once the cap is reached
children.note: A cap enforced before the job is queued is the only place refusing is free.
